# agy-fabric **Full Code Mode for Google Antigravity (`agy`)** [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-38BDF8?labelColor=0F172A&style=flat-square)](CHANGELOG.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-22C55E?labelColor=0F172A&style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Bun](https://img.shields.io/badge/bun-%3E%3D1.1-F9F1E1?labelColor=0F172A&style=flat-square&logo=bun&logoColor=FBF0DF)](https://bun.sh) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-64748B?labelColor=0F172A&style=flat-square)](#quick-start) [![Compaction](https://img.shields.io/badge/compaction-0--LLM-7C3AED?labelColor=0F172A&style=flat-square)](#features) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/p-yan-6908/agy-fabric/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI&style=flat-square&labelColor=0F172A)](https://github.com/p-yan-6908/agy-fabric/actions) One warm, sandboxed TypeScript kernel for everything — file I/O, shell, code-graph navigation,
context offloading, deterministic 0-LLM compaction, MCP, skills, and parallel `agy` subagents. [Quick Start](#quick-start) · [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [fabric-swe results](https://p-yan-6908.github.io/fabric-swe/)
--- ## Why `agy-fabric`? Stock agent loops spend a model round-trip on every `read_file`, `grep`, `edit`, and `run_command` — and dump every byte of every result into the context window. `agy-fabric` wraps `agy` to run Antigravity with a minimal system prompt and a **single** tool, `fabric_exec`: a persistent, sandboxed TypeScript kernel that composes file I/O, shell commands, code-graph navigation, context offloading, compaction, MCP servers, skills, and subagents inside one program. Intermediate data stays in the kernel; only the returned value reaches the model. Powered by [Pi Fabric](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-fabric), [Pi Fovea](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-fovea), and [Pi Context Engineer](https://github.com/p-yan-6908/pi-context-engineer). ## Features - **Warm Sandboxed TypeScript Kernel (`fabric_exec`)** - Top-level `await` + `return` TypeScript execution in a persistent warm worker process (no cold-start penalty between calls; sandboxed via macOS `sandbox-exec` when available). - Composes `pi.read`, `pi.write`, `pi.edit`, `pi.grep`, `pi.find`, `pi.ls`, `pi.bash`, `mcp..`, `skills.list/load`, `state.get/set`, and `π` string payloads. - Intermediate data stays inside the kernel; only the returned value and `print()` output enter model context. - **Auto-Yield & Unified `tasks.*` Registry:** Programs still running at `yieldMs` (default `95s`; `0` disables) automatically yield `{ yielded: true, taskId }` before KV-cache TTL expiry while the worker continues uninterrupted in the background — inspect, collect, or cancel via `tasks.wait`, `tasks.get`, `tasks.list`, and `tasks.stop` (also tracks `pi.bash(cmd, { background: true })` tasks). - **Pi Fovea Code-Graph Navigation (`extensions.fovea_*`)** - Heat-ranked repository overviews (`fovea_sketch`), symbol/path/route focus (`fovea_focus`), neighborhood deepening (`fovea_dwell`), and blast-radius impact analysis (`fovea_impact`). - **Pi Context Engineer Offloading (`extensions.ctx_*`)** - Automatically offloads `fabric_exec` results `> 8.5 KB` to `.pi/context-store` with a compact handle + structural outline (sized below Antigravity's ~10 KB MCP file-spill threshold) and compacts oversized errors `> 4 KB`. - Inspect offloaded payloads inside `fabric_exec` via `extensions.ctx_read`, `extensions.ctx_summarize`, and `extensions.ctx_offload` without re-running commands. - **Deterministic 0-LLM Compaction & Lossless Recall (`compact.*`, `memory.expand`, `agy-compact`)** - Uses `pi-fabric`'s deterministic algorithmic compactor (`0` LLM calls) to summarize transcripts into a compact handoff and inject them automatically on `SessionStart`. - Intercepts `/compact [instructions]` via `PreInvocation` hook, auto-stages compaction when context occupancy crosses 65%, and supports persistent `[Carry Forward]` items and lossless transcript recall via `memory.expand`. - Concurrent terminal sessions are isolated per `agy` PID. - **Parallel `agy` Subagents (`agents.run`)** - Spawn nested `agy` subagents directly from TypeScript (fan out with `Promise.all`), inheriting your active `agy` model by default or configurable via `FABRIC_SUBAGENT_MODEL` / `fabric.json`. - **Clean TUI Visuals (`server/tui-proxy.mjs` + `server/run-tracker.mjs`)** - Replaces raw `Called N MCP tools (fabric_fabric/fabric_exec ×N)` rows, generic `Calling MCP tool...` spinners, and wrapped JSON dumps in `ctrl+o` with live Fabric program names, descriptions, op breakdowns, and durations: - Collapsed: `● Fabric · 12 runs ✓ Read ×14 · Edit ×4 · Bash ×3 · 8.2s (ctrl+o)` - Expanded (`ctrl+o`): `│ ✓ read_pkg · Read ×1 · 11ms` + indented description & op summary - Automatically bypassed in non-TTY / `-p` print mode, or opt out anytime with `agy --plain` / `AGY_FABRIC_PLAIN=1`. - Runs agy in its full-screen (alternate screen) rendering mode by default, so the TUI stays intact when the tab is backgrounded or the terminal reflows. Use `agy --inline` / `AGY_FABRIC_INLINE=1` (or save a `Rendering Mode` in `/config`) to keep native inline scrollback. - **Optional Live Telemetry Statusline (`scripts/statusline.sh`)** - Displays model, context %, cumulative session tokens, cache hit % (last turn + session avg), and quota — and feeds live token telemetry into `compact.pressure()`. --- ## Prerequisites - [Antigravity CLI (`agy`)](https://antigravity.google) installed and authenticated - [Bun](https://bun.sh) (`>= 1.1`) - Recommended: `rg` (ripgrep) for fast `pi.grep`/`pi.find`, and `jq` if using the optional statusline --- ## Quick Start One-command install: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/p-yan-6908/agy-fabric/main/install.sh | bash ``` Then start a Fabric Code Mode session: ```bash agy ```
Install from a local clone ```bash git clone https://github.com/p-yan-6908/agy-fabric.git cd agy-fabric ./install.sh ``` To also install the live context telemetry statusline: ```bash ./install.sh --with-statusline ```
What `install.sh` does: 1. Installs the Antigravity plugin to `~/.gemini/config/plugins/fabric` (with resolved `bun` and script paths in `mcp_config.json` and `hooks.json`). 2. Runs `bun install --production` inside the plugin directory to install `pi-fabric`, `pi-fovea`, and `pi-context-engineer`. 3. Installs `agy` and `agy-compact` into `~/.local/bin` (override with `--bin-dir`), preserving any existing stock `agy` binary at `~/.local/bin/.agy-orig/agy` (restored by `./uninstall.sh`). 4. Runs `agy plugin validate ~/.gemini/config/plugins/fabric --strict`. To uninstall: ```bash ./uninstall.sh ``` --- ## Usage ```bash # Start an interactive Fabric Code Mode session (with clean TUI visuals) agy # Start without the visual PTY compositor (raw agy output) agy --plain # Keep agy's native inline (scrollback) rendering instead of full screen agy --inline # Launch stock Antigravity CLI without Fabric Code Mode agy --no-fabric # One-shot prompt mode agy -p="Sketch this repository with Fovea and summarize its entrypoints" # Deterministic 0-LLM compaction into a fresh session window agy-compact agy-compact "Keep auth token refresh invariant" agy-compact --stage-only # stage for next /new without launching agy agy-compact --status # inspect carry-forward items and staged/committed state agy-compact --carry "item" # add a persistent [Carry Forward] item agy-compact --cancel # cancel a pending staged compaction ``` > **Tip:** Inside an active `agy` session, running `/compact [optional focus]` is intercepted by the `PreInvocation` hook to run `pi-fabric`'s deterministic 0-LLM compactor and stage the summary for `/new`. --- ## Inside `fabric_exec` All capabilities are exposed as globals inside each `fabric_exec` TypeScript program: | Namespace | Key APIs | | --- | --- | | **Core (`pi`)** | `pi.read`, `pi.write`, `pi.edit`, `pi.grep`, `pi.find`, `pi.ls`, `pi.bash` | | **Fovea (`extensions`)** | `extensions.fovea_sketch`, `extensions.fovea_focus`, `extensions.fovea_dwell`, `extensions.fovea_impact` | | **Context Engineer (`extensions`)** | `extensions.ctx_read`, `extensions.ctx_summarize`, `extensions.ctx_offload` | | **Compaction & Recall** | `compact.pressure`, `compact.carry`, `compact.request`, `compact.status`, `compact.cancel`, `memory.expand` | | **Tasks & Auto-Yield (`tasks` / `bg`)** | `tasks.wait`, `tasks.get`, `tasks.list`, `tasks.stop` | | **MCP, Skills & Subagents** | `mcp..(args)`, `tools.list/search/describe`, `skills.list/load`, `agents.run`, `state.get/set`, `π.` | --- ## Configuration Settings are merged in order from: 1. `~/.pi/agent/fabric.json` 2. `~/.pi/fabric.json` 3. `/.pi/fabric.json` Example `~/.pi/fabric.json`: ```json { "executor": { "timeoutMs": 600000, "yieldMs": 95000, "inlineMaxBytes": 8500 }, "agents": { "maxConcurrent": 8, "defaultModel": "auto", "modelAliases": { "fast": "your-fast-model-id" } }, "compaction": { "targetContextRatio": 0.65, "outputReserveTokens": 16000, "pressureBands": { "warn": 0.6, "urgent": 0.8 } } } ``` ### Environment Variables - `FABRIC_SUBAGENT_MODEL`: Default `--model` flag passed to `agy` subagents spawned via `agents.run` (when unset, subagents inherit `agy`'s active default model). - `AGY_BIN`: Override path to the underlying stock `agy` binary used by the `agy` launcher, `agy-compact`, and `agents.run`. - `AGY_FABRIC_PLAIN`: Set to `1` to bypass the PTY visual compositor by default (same as `--plain`). - `AGY_FABRIC_INLINE`: Set to `1` to keep inline scrollback rendering instead of full-screen mode (same as `--inline`). - `AGY_FABRIC_PLUGIN_DIR`: Override installed plugin directory (default: `~/.gemini/config/plugins/fabric`). - `AGY_FABRIC_BIN_DIR`: Override target bin directory for `agy` and `agy-compact` (default: `~/.local/bin`). --- ## Optional Statusline Setup If you installed `scripts/statusline.sh` (`./install.sh --with-statusline`), enable it in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json`: ```json { "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh", "enabled": true } } ``` This both renders the live statusline and writes per-session context telemetry to `/tmp/agy-fabric-/sessions/` so `compact.pressure()` and auto-staging have live token counts. --- ## Benchmarks Measured by [fabric-swe](https://p-yan-6908.github.io/fabric-swe/): `pi` + `pi-fabric` (full code mode) + `pi-fovea` vs. vanilla `pi` (built-in tools only) — same model, prompts, sandbox, time budget, and grader on real-repository coding tasks. The same `fabric_exec` kernel powers this plugin. | Model | Arm | Resolved | Mean tool calls | Mean wall | Mean cost | | --- | --- | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | | GPT-6.1 Sol | fabric-fovea | **10/10** | **23.3** | **12.9 min** | **$0.56** | | | vanilla | 9/10 | 67.8 | 13.7 min | $0.59 | | GPT-6.1 Terra | fabric-fovea | 8/10 | **42.6** | **11.6 min** | **$0.99** | | | vanilla | **9/10** | 106.4 | 13.9 min | $1.11 | | GPT-6 Luna | fabric-fovea | 7/10 | **42.9** | 26.2 min | $0.08 | | | vanilla | **8/10** | 98.8 | **22.9 min** | $0.08 | Code mode cuts tool calls by **57–66%** at comparable resolve rates (within noise at *n* = 10). Full per-task data, methodology, and run files: [p-yan-6908/fabric-swe](https://github.com/p-yan-6908/fabric-swe). --- ## Repository Structure ```text . ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── agents/fabric.md # Minimal full-codemode agent prompt ├── hooks.json # SessionStart / PreInvocation / PreToolUse / Stop hooks ├── mcp_config.json # Fabric MCP server config ├── assets/logo.svg # Plugin icon ├── server/ │ ├── mcp-server.mjs # Fabric MCP server + extension hosts + subagent runner │ ├── kernel.mjs # Warm sandboxed guest TypeScript kernel │ ├── compactor.mjs # Deterministic 0-LLM transcript compactor │ ├── hook-cwd.mjs # Lifecycle hook handler (PID-isolated session tracking) │ ├── run-tracker.mjs # PID-isolated live run/op telemetry snapshots │ ├── tui-proxy.mjs # Zero-flicker PTY visual compositor for agy │ ├── vt-screen.mjs # Lightweight VT100 shadow screen tracker │ ├── budget.mjs # Output clipping helpers │ └── resolve-deps.mjs # Portable package resolver for pi-* dependencies ├── bin/ │ ├── agy # `agy --agent fabric` launcher │ └── agy-compact # CLI for deterministic compaction & carry-forward items ├── scripts/ │ └── statusline.sh # Optional live token telemetry statusline ├── install.sh # One-command installer └── uninstall.sh # Clean uninstaller ``` --- ## Credits Built on top of: - [`pi-fabric`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-fabric) — programmable tool runtime & deterministic algorithmic compaction - [`pi-fovea`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-fovea) — foveated heat-diffusion code graph - [`pi-context-engineer`](https://github.com/p-yan-6908/pi-context-engineer) — boundary offloading & structural previews ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
